pool.english: Ramadan is the most beautiful month of the year.
At iftar the whole family sits together.
We wake up at three for suhoor.
Everyone waits to see the crescent moon.
Eid al-Fitr lasts three days.
On Eid al-Adha people go on Hajj.
We share the sacrifice meat with the poor.
On Eid we serve coffee and halwa.
The Ramadan cannon fires at sunset.
The suhoor drummer walks through the neighbourhood at night.
After iftar my father goes to Taraweeh prayers.
We pay zakat before Eid.

pool.arabic: بحق الليلة العيال يلفون على البيوت.
pool.arabicTashkeel: بحَق الليلة العْيال يْلِفّون على البيوت.
pool.english: On Haq al-Laila the kids go door to door.
On National Day the streets are decorated.

pool.arabic: ليلة راس السنة في ألعاب نارية ببرج خليفة.
pool.arabicTashkeel: ليلة راس السَّنة في ألعاب نارية ببُرج خَليفة.
pool.english: On New Year's Eve there are fireworks at Burj Khalifa.
pool.transliteration: leelat raas is-sana fee al3aab naariyya b-burj khaleefa.

pool.english: In Ramadan, the streets are quiet before iftar.
Iftar starts with dates and water.
A light suhoor: yogurt, bread and dates.
Did they see the crescent moon?
Happy Eid al-Fitr!
Eid al-Adha is four days.
My uncle bought a sheep for the sacrifice.
Omani halwa is famous.
The kids wait for the Ramadan cannon.
The suhoor drummer wakes us up with his drum.
Taraweeh prayers are long.
Zakat is for the poor.
Haq al-Laila is in the middle of Sha'ban.
National Day is on the second of December.
Happy New Year!
Ramadan is a month of patience.
Iftar at grandma's house.
Don't miss suhoor!
The crescent appeared, Eid is tomorrow.
Children get Eid money on Eid al-Fitr.
The pilgrims return after Eid al-Adha.
The sacrifice is shared in three parts.
The smell of halwa and saffron fills the house.
The Ramadan cannon is an old tradition.
The kids follow the suhoor drummer.
The mosque is full for Taraweeh.
How much is the zakat?
The Haq al-Laila songs are beautiful.

pool.arabic: باليوم الوطني الكل يلبس ألوان العلم.
pool.arabicTashkeel: باليوم الوَطَني الكِل يِلبَس ألوان العَلَم.
pool.english: On National Day, everyone wears the flag colours.
pool.transliteration: bil-yoom il-watani il-kill yilbas alwaan il-3alam.

pool.english: New Year is a holiday in the UAE.
The last days of Ramadan.
What's for iftar today?
Suhoor at four.
The new crescent.
New clothes for Eid al-Fitr.
Eid al-Adha prayers.
Halwa with coffee.
Zakat and charity in Ramadan.

sentences.english: Ramadan in the Gulf has a special atmosphere.

sentences.arabic: قبل الفجر أبو طبيلة يلف بالفريج.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: قَبل الفَجر أبو طْبَيلة يْلِف بالفَريج.
sentences.english: Before dawn, the suhoor drummer walks through the neighbourhood.
sentences.transliteration: gabil il-fajr abu tbaila yliff bil-fireej.

sentences.arabic: وقت المغرب يضرب مدفع رمضان، والعوايل يفطرون على تمر وماي.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: وَقت المَغرِب يِضرِب مِدفَع رَمَضان، والعوايِل يْفَطرون على تَمر وماي.
sentences.english: At sunset the Ramadan cannon fires, and families break the fast with dates and water.
sentences.transliteration: wagt il-maghrib yidhrib midfa3 ramadhaan, w-il-3awaayil yfatroon 3ala tamr w-maay.

sentences.arabic: بعد الفطور، الرجاجيل يروحون التراويح، بعدين يزورون المجالس لين متأخر.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَعد الفُطور، الرْجاجيل يْروحون التَّراويح، بَعدين يزورون المَجالِس لين مِتأخِّر.
sentences.english: After iftar, the men go to Taraweeh, then visit the majlis until late.
sentences.transliteration: ba3d il-futoor, ir-ryaayeel yroo7oon it-taraawee7, ba3dain yzooroon il-majaalis leen mit2akhkhir.

sentences.arabic: بآخر الشهر، الكل ينطر الهلال حق العيد.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بآخِر الشَّهَر، الكِل يِنطِر الهِلال حَق العيد.
sentences.english: At the end of the month, everyone waits for the crescent to announce Eid.
sentences.transliteration: b-aakhir ish-shahar, il-kill yintir il-hilaal 7agg il-3eed.

sentences.arabic: البيوت ريحتها حلوى، والعيال يعدون العيدية.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: البيوت ريحتها حَلوى، والعْيال يْعِدّون العيدية.
sentences.english: The houses smell of halwa, and the kids count their Eid money.

sentences.arabic: الإمارات فيها عطل حق مناسبات وايد.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: الإمارات فيها عُطَل حَق مُناسَبات وايد.
sentences.english: The UAE has holidays for many occasions.

sentences.arabic: العيدين، اليوم الوطني بثنين ديسمبر، وراس السنة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: العيدين، اليوم الوَطَني بثْنين دِيسَمبَر، وراس السَّنة.
sentences.english: The two Eids, National Day on the second of December, and New Year.
sentences.transliteration: il-3eedain, il-yoom il-watani b-thneen deesambar, w-raas is-sana.

sentences.arabic: باليوم الوطني السيارات مزينة والكل يحتفل سوا.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: باليوم الوَطَني السَّيّارات مْزَيَّنة والكِل يِحتِفِل سَوا.
sentences.english: On National Day, cars are decorated and everyone celebrates together.
sentences.transliteration: bil-yoom il-watani is-sayyaaraat mzayyana w-il-kill yi7tifil sawa.

scenario.situation: It is the first week of Ramadan, and an Emirati colleague invites the student to iftar and explains the Ramadan traditions.
scenario.otherRole: The Emirati colleague, who loves Ramadan.
scenario.goalEnglish: Ask about iftar, suhoor and Taraweeh, learn about the cannon and Haq al-Laila, and ask how Eid is celebrated.
